an7.53:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ cārikaṃ caranti mahatā bhikkhu saṅghena saddhiṃ.
an7.53:1.3: tena kho pana samayena veḷukaṇṭakī nandamātā upāsikā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya pārāyaṇaṃ sarena bhāsati.
an7.53:2.1: tena kho pana samayena vessavaṇo mahārājā uttarāya disāya dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati kenacideva karaṇīyena.
an7.53:2.2: assosi kho vessavaṇo mahārājā nandamātāya upāsikāya pārāyaṇaṃ sarena bhāsantiyā. sutvā kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno aṭṭhāsi.
an7.53:3.1: atha kho nandamātā upāsikā pārāyaṇaṃ sarena bhāsitvā tuṇhī ahosi.
an7.53:3.2: atha kho vessavaṇo mahārājā nandamātāya upāsikāya kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā abbhanumodi:
an7.53:3.5: ahaṃ te bhaginī bhātā vessavaṇo mahārājāti.
an7.53:3.6: sādhu bhadramukha, tena hi yo me ayaṃ dhammapariyāyo bhaṇito, idante hotu ātitheyyanti.
an7.53:3.7: sādhu bhaginī, etaṃ ceva me hotu ātitheyyaṃ:
an7.53:3.8: sve ca sāriputta moggallānapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso veḷukaṇṭakaṃ āgamissati. tañca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisitvā mama dakkhiṇaṃ ādiseyyāsi.
an7.53:4.1: atha kho nandamātā upāsikā tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpesi.
an7.53:4.2: atha kho sāriputtamoggallānapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso yena veḷukaṇṭako tadavasari.
an7.53:4.3: atha kho nandamātā upāsikā aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
an7.53:4.4: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhusaṅghassa kālaṃ ārocehi:
an7.53:4.5: ‘kālo bhante, ayyāya nandamātuyā nivesane niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta’nti.
an7.53:4.6: evaṃ ayye’ti kho so puriso nandamātāya upāsikāya paṭissutvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhusaṅghassa kālaṃ ārocesi:
an7.53:4.7: ‘kālo bhante, ayyāya nandamātuyā nivesane niṭṭhitaṃ bhattanti’.
an7.53:4.8: atha kho sāriputtamoggallānapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena nandamātuyā upāsikāya nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññattāsane nisīdi.
an7.53:4.9: atha kho nandamātā upāsikā sāriputtamoggallānapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
an7.53:5.1: atha kho nandamātā upāsikā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an7.53:5.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nandamātaraṃ upāsikaṃ āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca:
an7.53:5.3: ko pana te nandamāte, bhikkhusaṅghassa abbhāgamanaṃ ārocesīti.
an7.53:6.1: idhāhaṃ bhante, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya pārāyaṇaṃ sarena bhāsitvā tuṇhī ahosiṃ.
an7.53:6.2: atha kho bhante, vessavaṇo mahārājā mama kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā abbhanumodi
an7.53:6.5: ahaṃ te bhagini, bhātā vessavaṇo mahārājā.
an7.53:6.6: sādhu bhadramukha, tena hi yo me ayaṃ dhammapariyāyo bhaṇito, idaṃ te hotu ātitheyyanti.
an7.53:6.7: sādhu bhagini, etañceva me hotu ātitheyyaṃ:
an7.53:6.8: sve ca sāriputtamoggallānapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso veḷukaṇṭakaṃ āgamissati. tañca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisitvā mama dakkhiṇaṃ ādiseyyāsi.
an7.53:6.10: yadidaṃ bhante, dāne puññaṃ hi taṃ vessavaṇassa mahārājassa sukhāya hotūti. (1)
an7.53:7.2: yatra hi nāma vessavaṇena mahārājena evaṃ mahiddhikena evaṃ mahesakkhena devaputtena sammukhā sallapissatīti. (2)
an7.53:8.1: na kho me bhante, esova acchariyo abbhuto dhammo.
an7.53:8.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:8.3: idha me bhante nando nāma eko puttako piyo manāpo.
an7.53:8.4: taṃ rājāno kismiñcideva pakaraṇe okkassa paggayha jīvitā voropesuṃ.
an7.53:8.5: tasmiṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante, dārake gahite vā gayhamāne vā baddhe vā vajjhamāne vā hate vā haññamāne vā nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattanti.
an7.53:9.1: na kho me bhante, esova acchariyo abbhuto dhammo.
an7.53:9.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:9.3: idha me bhante, sāmiko kālakato assa aññataraṃ yakkhayoniṃ upapanno.
an7.53:9.4: so me teneva purimena attabhāvena uddasseti.
an7.53:9.5: na kho panāhaṃ bhante, abhijānāmi tato nidānaṃ cittassa aññathattanti.
an7.53:10.1: na kho me bhante, esova acchariyo abbhuto dhammo.
an7.53:10.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:10.3: yatohaṃ bhante, sāmikassa daharasseva daharā ānītā, nābhijānāmi sāmikaṃ manasāpi aticaritā, kuto pana kāyenāti.
an7.53:11.1: na kho me bhante, esova acchariyo abbhuto dhammo.
an7.53:11.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:11.3: yadāhaṃ bhante, upāsikā paṭidesitā, nābhijānāmi kiñci sikkhāpadaṃ sañcicca vītikkamitāti.
an7.53:12.1: na kho me bhante, esova acchariyo abbhuto dhammo.
an7.53:12.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:12.3: idhāhaṃ bhante, yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an7.53:12.4: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an7.53:12.5: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhakā ca viharāmi, satā ca sampajānā sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi. yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhantī upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an7.53:12.6: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassa domanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an7.53:13.1: na kho me bhante esova acchariyo abbhuto dhammo.
an7.53:13.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:13.3: yānimāni bhante, bhagavatā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni, nāhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmi.
an7.53:14.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto nandamātaraṃ upāsikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti. nandamātusuttaṃ
